summary: Revalidate a previously computed atomic byte index after argument coercions that may resize or grow backing storage.

semantics.purpose: coercions can execute arbitrary user code and change bounds
semantics.failure: throws if access is no longer valid

tests.name: coercion side effect considered
tests.input: // semantic IR: compute atomic index; value coercion changes backing-store bounds; revalidate before access

tests.name: no stale bounds
tests.input: // semantic IR: stale byte index is not blindly reused after observable value coercion
